# Layout Change Impact Scan

Evaluate blast radius for layout/CSS modifications.

## Checks

- Shared Device vs Multiplayer pages
- Mobile portrait/landscape/tablet/desktop
- Active player emphasis and control affordances

## Output

```text
Impact Areas:
- <area>
High-Risk Breakpoints:
- <breakpoint>
Suggested Verification:
- <step>
```
